Row2 fireflies over fixed area: seven gold and green glints trace curved short flight paths over four frames, glints open and close. Row3 distant storm lightning loop: faint clouds with small arc, large branched lightning, residual branching afterglow, faint cloud. Row4 blue-gold portal loop: oval ring twists, spiral expands, opposite rotating wisps, closed ring. Stable emitter same size.
